episode.title: AI Website Side Hustles
episode.description:
Show Links
• Get the top 80+ AI Models for $8.99 at AI Box: https://aibox.ai
• How I Grow and Scale My Business with AI: https://www.skool.com/aihustle
• Get the AI Chat Daily Newsletter: https://www.aichatdaily.com/newsletter
In this episode, we examine a viral side hustle involving cold calling businesses with poor websites and offering AI-assisted website creation. While there may be potential for profit, the challenges of cold calling and the oversimplification of the process are thoroughly discussed, leading to suggestions for more sustainable business strategies.

Chapters
00:00 Introduction to Viral Hustles
02:01 Challenges of Cold Calling
03:59 Sustainability of the Strategy
06:02 Alternatives to One-Time Sales
